facts.label: Past progressive com when
facts.sub: Use was/were + -ing para a ação em andamento e o passado simples depois de when: I was walking home when it started to rain.

facts.label: Passado contínuo
facts.sub: Para dizer o que estava acontecendo, use was ou were + verbo com -ing: I was walking home. We were running. É uma ação em andamento num momento do passado.

facts.label: Quando
facts.sub: When liga a ação longa e a ação curta: I was walking when it started to rain. Depois de when, use o passado simples: started, heard, went out.

pages.title: A quiet street · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Sunday morning on a quiet street in Seattle. The ground is still wet. Ivy opens her front door. Her neighbor Ben stands by the fence. A big storm hit the city last night. They both want to tell their stories.
“Hi, Ivy! Where were you when the storm started?” says Ivy. “I was walking home when it started to rain.” says Ben. “Were you carrying an umbrella?” says Ivy.

pages.title: Laboratório de sons · o som
pages.what: Was soa “uóz” e were soa “uâr”: o som é curto. Walking soa “uóquing”.
pages.tip: Compare was e were: uóz e uâr.

solo: Modele, peça repetição, depois uso livre.
